configurations.name: tivot
runtimeArgs:
import os,functools,http.server
p=int(os.environ.get('PORT','8000'))
h=functools.partial(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, directory=os.getcwd())
# ThreadingHTTPServer：單執行緒版會被一條 keep-alive 連線卡住，backlog 填滿之後
# 新連線一律 connection refused —— 症狀與「伺服器被回收」一模一樣（ver -1370 實測）。
http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer.allow_reuse_address=True
srv=http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('',p),h)
srv.daemon_threads=True
print('serving on',p,flush=True)
srv.serve_forever()
